notes.title: Update v1.0.2 Scroll with keyboard - Sell & buy at no loss
notes.notes:
new feature:

scroll left with 'A' or 'LEFT ARROW'
scroll right with 'D' or 'RIGHT ARROW'

gameplay:

selling and buying again at no loss

prices for next plant, totem or animal back to previous price after selling (or freeing spirit)
